glosses: inhabiting; said of something that inhabits

examples.text: El pueblo tenía más de mil habitantes.
examples.en: The village had more than a thousand inhabitants.
The city has a large population.

examples.text: Los habitantes de la isla son amigables.
examples.en: The inhabitants of the island are friendly.

examples.text: Es un pueblecito de doscientos habitantes.
examples.en: It's a village of two hundred inhabitants.

examples.text: Los habitantes de la ciudad dependen del río para beber agua.
examples.en: The inhabitants of the city depend upon the river for drinking water.
